data.name: Divided We Fall: Play For Free
data.detailed_description:
Divided We Fall is a close-combat multiplayer game with team-driven strategy at its core set in various battlefields of the Second World War.

The four soldiers under your command rely on you to keep them alive, and your commander relies on you to achieve your objectives. Doing both will require effective use of terrain for cover, smart positioning, and taking advantage of the strengths and weaknesses of different weapons. And never forget that Divided We Fall… work together with your teammates and everyone’s chances of survival go up!

Hone your skills in PvP or Cooperative battles in anything from quick 1 vs 1 skirmishes to massive conflicts with up to 120 soldiers commanded by up to 15 players per team. In team games, working together is paramount! If you are the highest ranking officer, you will draw out your battle plan and distribute weapons to your subordinates through an in-game map board interface. But as a lower ranking leader you still have the responsibility to lead your squad to achieve the objective set by your commander, and coordinate with friendly players to adapt the plan within the chaos of battle.

Forge strong bonds of brotherhood in this intense multiplayer combat, for Divided we Fall…

Key Features:
  • Intense real-time World War II battles where teamwork is the key to victory
  • Use the terrain to provide cover for your troops and create deadly kill zones and ambushes
  • Squad-based action combined with team play that has a clear military chain of command
  • Compete with your clan via ranking systems, leaderboards and competitions
  • Command your fire team successfully in PvP or Coop, and strive to become a general

The free version of the game will give access to the following:
  • All weapons
  • Regiment competition system
  • Leaderboards
  • All official maps
  • Map editor and custom made maps
  • Access to the good old Call of Combat
  • Modding system
  • Steam achievements

    Make sure to follow us on Twitter @Kava_GameStudio and talk with us via .

data.short_description: Unite and fight your way to victory! Divided we Fall is a strategic close-combat multiplayer game that emphasizes the importance of building an effective cohesive squad and executing well thought-out tactics on the battlefield.

reviews.review:
"Divided We Fall" - multiplayer real-time tactical game, giving to player a squad of 4 soldiers and a quest to capture and control as many battlefield key points as possible, RISK-style. It was really promising back in 2016 in Early Access, but now, almost 3 years after... it is still not that much fun and/or challenge, as some RTS fans would want from the multiplayer skirmishes.

Basically, all that I saw in the game besides almost-empty lobby, was a grenade tossing marathon. Soldiers, both from your and opposite side, are pretty lame at shooting, even when they are supposed to defend, "hold the point". Grenade tossing, on the contrary, is still the best battle tactic available (can't say you have many options to choose from).

So every game is basically a short C&C mission, without any troop building, gross planning and material redistribution. You only send your troops, by 1 or 2 groups, to "conquer" key points, and, with any luck, blowing your rivals off the map with some hand bomb blasts. It's still a very primitive micromanagement contest, without much variability or fun in the process.

Therefore I can not recommend the game, despite the basic edition is free-of-cost. Mark? Let's say 5/10. The game had some potential but did not take off from the ground, which is detrimental for multiplayer projects.
